d.ko: Salt 2 is a pirate-themed open world adventure focused on exploration, crafting, and survival. Play solo or with up to 5 friends, sailing the sea with your ship as a mobile base. Discover islands full of quests, towns, caves, and secrets. Level up, craft gear, hunt, fish, and customize your ship.

d.zh: Salt 2 是一款以海盗为主题的开放世界冒险，专注探索、制作和生存。可单人或与最多 5 名好友航海，把你的船当作移动基地。发现充满任务、城镇、洞穴和秘密的岛屿。升级、打造装备、狩猎、钓鱼并自定义你的船。
